items.prompt:
Use my uploaded face reference image and my uploaded full-body reference image as the only identity and body reference.
Create a completely realistic cinematic photograph of the same person from my references. Preserve my exact face identity, right side profile, facial structure, glasses, hairstyle, beard shape, ears, skin details, body proportions, height and natural physique. Do not change my face. Do not create a different person. The person in the image must be me.
Scene: A lonely rainy night city street with a cinematic atmosphere. A modern glass bus stop shelter is placed in the middle background with soft pink neon lights glowing inside. The street is wet after rain and the asphalt reflects the neon pink light. There is light fog, dark trees, distant street lights and a quiet empty urban environment.
The man is walking slowly from the right side of the frame, completely in right-side profile view, looking forward naturally. He is passing in front of the bus stop, but he is several meters away from the bus stop and not close to the camera.
VERY IMPORTANT CAMERA DISTANCE: The camera must be positioned extremely far away from the subject, around 200 meters distance. This must be a very wide cinematic establishing shot, not a close shot.
Do not move the camera closer. Do not create a portrait composition. Do not zoom in.
The man and the bus stop should appear relatively small inside a large environment. Show a huge amount of the rainy street, empty space, reflections on the wet ground, trees, street lights and atmosphere around the character.
The full body of the man must be visible from head to toe. Keep the exact side profile walking pose. The image should feel like a movie scene where the viewer is watching the character from far away.
Camera style: Ultra wide cinematic composition, distant camera perspective, professional cinema camera, 24mm wide-angle lens look, deep environment, realistic perspective, natural proportions.
Style and clothing: Keep my real body shape and proportions from the reference.
I am wearing:
oversized white t-shirt with a modern stylish streetwear look
loose modern baggy pants matching the atmosphere
fashionable modern sneakers
a luxury expensive watch on my left wrist
Photography style: Ultra realistic professional cinematic photography. Dark movie color grading. Realistic night lighting. Natural shadows. Real rain atmosphere. High-end camera quality. Real human skin texture. No AI appearance. No artificial face. No cartoon style. No unrealistic body proportions.
Aspect ratio: Vertical 9:16 Instagram Reels format.
Final image should look like a real frame from a high-budget movie, captured from a very far distance, not an AI-generated image.
